name: Alpengasthaus Stockerhof
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Alpengasthof Stockerhof in Tirol** Nestled in the heart of the **Zillertal Alps**, **Alpengasthof Stockerhof** invites you to experience authentic Tyrolean hospitality at its finest. Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, this cozy mountain retreat offers breathtaking views of snow-capped peaks and lush alpine meadows. ### **A Taste of Tradition** Indulge in hearty **Tiroler** dishes crafted with local ingredients. Start your day with a **Kaiserschmarrn** drizzled with apricot jam or savor a steaming bowl of **Käsespätzle** after a day on the slopes. Our **Schmankerl** (specialties) include fresh trout from the **Ziller River** and homemade **Apfelstrudel** for dessert. ### **Adventure Awaits** Whether you're skiing in winter or hiking in summer, **Stockerhof** is your perfect base. In winter, glide down the slopes of **Ahorn** or **Gerlos**—both just minutes away. In summer, explore the **Zillertal**’s pristine trails, including the famous **Zillertal Arena** or the scenic **Hahntennjoch** hike. ### **Relax & Unwind** After an active day, unwind in our rustic **Stube** (living room) with a glass of **Tiroler** wine or a warm **Glühwein**. The crackling fireplace and panoramic views make every moment feel like a retreat. ### **Family-Friendly & Pet-Friendly** We welcome families with children and furry friends. Our cozy rooms and play areas ensure a memorable stay for all. ### **Location & Access** Easily reachable via the **Zillertal Road (B189)**, **Stockerhof** is just a 30-minute drive from **Innsbruck Airport**.
